intent: Sum available_today units of the Fischer SX 7UY-G03 cavity-fixing anchor/wall-plug across every open PowerTool branch in Graz (including 0-availability branches) and cite all Graz store records plus the product record.
success_criteria: Resolves exactly one product SKU matching brand=Fischer, model=SX 7UY-G03, anchor_type=cavity fixing
Total = SUM(available_today_quantity) over all open Graz stores (0-availability branches contribute 0 but are still enumerated)
refs include the product record path and every open Graz city store record path

args.stdin: SELECT v.product_sku, v.record_path FROM product_variants v JOIN product_variant_properties p ON p.product_sku = v.product_sku WHERE v.brand = :brand AND v.series = :series AND v.model = :model AND p.property_key = 'anchor_type' AND p.property_value_text = :anchor_type;
SELECT store_id, record_path FROM stores WHERE city = :city AND is_open = 1 ORDER BY store_id;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(si.available_today_quantity), 0) AS total FROM stores s LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = s.store_id AND si.product_sku = :sku WHERE s.city = :city AND s.is_open = 1;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
